stilus: Warm, calm and reassuring, like a trusted private banker personally welcoming a new client: unhurried, friendly, clear, a gentle smile in the voice, welcoming and grateful, a little brighter at the start. Native Hungarian speaker born and raised in Budapest: strictly Hungarian phonetics and intonation, stress always on the first syllable, long and short vowels kept distinct, no foreign accent at all.
